description: This file defines the RequestCompressionMiddleware class, which provides middleware functionality for compressing HTTP request payloads based on service operation requirements within the AWS SDK for PHP.

classes.name: RequestCompressionMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for handling request payload compression based on operation settings and request conditions.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Creates a middleware wrapper function for configuring compression settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the middleware with the next handler and configuration.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main method that processes the request, determines if compression should be applied, and performs compression if needed.

methods.name: compressRequestBody
methods.description: Compresses the request body using the selected encoding.

methods.name: determineEncoding
methods.description: Determines the encoding function to use based on available encodings.

methods.name: shouldCompressRequestBody
methods.description: Evaluates whether the request body should be compressed based on size, headers, and operation traits.

methods.name: hasStreamingTraitWithoutRequiresLength
methods.description: Checks if the operation input has streaming members without a required length, influencing compression decisions.

methods.name: determineMinimumCompressionSize
methods.description: Calculates and validates the minimum size threshold for compression based on configuration.

methods.name: isValidCompressionSize
methods.description: Validates that the compression size is a numeric, non-negative integer within acceptable bounds.
